description: This file contains implementation of a stepper motor control module, including functions for motor initialization, position management, movement control, thread handling, and position storage using backup RAM. It manages stepper motor parking, direction, and pulse generation, integrated with project-specific hardware abstraction and threading.

classes.name: StepperMotor
classes.description: Represents a stepper motor with properties for position, direction, and hardware pin configurations, providing methods for initialization, position management, direction control, and pulse generation.

methods.name: saveStepperPos
methods.description: Saves the current position of the stepper motor to backup RAM or RTC register.

methods.name: loadStepperPos
methods.description: Loads the saved stepper motor position from backup RAM or RTC register.

methods.name: stThread
methods.description: Thread function managing the stepper motor movement based on target position, handling parking, direction, and position updates.
